$description: WinUI 3 touch input-tier overrides (40px hit target and controls, 16/20/24px icons).

size.$description: Font sizes per type role for touch input.

line-height.$description: Line heights per type role, as a multiple of the role's font size (DTCG's unitless lineHeight); `tokens:build` states the whole points it works out to.

dimension.$description: Touch layout density, control geometry, and icon sizes.

size.$description: Ergonomic sizing scales for touch input.

hit.$description: Minimum hit target size (0 disables padding expansion).

item.$description: WinUI 3 menu rows: the fill 4px in from the flyout's edge (MenuFlyoutItemMargin 4,2,4,2) and the text 11px inside it (MenuFlyoutItemThemePadding 11,8,11,9; ComboBoxItemThemePadding 11,5,11,7), the same with a pen or a finger (microsoft-ui-xaml MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml).

control.$description: Control internal spacing and switch size tier.
